common_rules:
Repo: worktree C:/Developer/PeasyPrints-kada18, branch kada-18/implement-redesign (from dev). Swoop (Next 16, React, Tailwind, Clerk, Firebase Admin). Edit only the files listed in your package; do not commit or push (the lead does).
No live services: never call Firebase, Clerk, Razorpay or any database. Build against types, the in-memory fakes and fixtures. Fixture mode: NEXT_PUBLIC_SWOOP_FIXTURES=1 in dev (src/lib/firebase/fixtureMode.ts); pick the user with /api/dev/fixture-user?id=<fixture id>&next=<path>. Dev server: npm run dev -- -p 3018.
Next 16 is not the Next you know: read the matching guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before using routing, params, searchParams, useSearchParams or proxy APIs. params and searchParams are Promises.
Pure modules that node tests import: '@/...' only as `import type`; runtime imports relative with the .ts extension; no enums or constructor parameter properties. Tests live at tests/<dir>/<name>.test.ts and use node:test with node:assert/strict.
Design: Swoop design system v1 in src/components/swoop (primitives, icons, illustrations). Dense layout. Sentence case, never the `uppercase` class. Copy in plain English, each line under 10 words, 'Hey' greetings. Trust line 'Only verified students'; never 'Free. No broker. Student to student.'. Prices via formatPrice ('Rs 1.5k', 'Rs 8.5k pp', 'Rs 1.2L dep'), never the rupee sign. Distance via formatFromCampus ('650 m from KJU, 8 min walk'). Gender options 'For girls / For boys / Anyone'. No stock photos: student uploads only, else an illustration or icon tile. Never ask students which campus or area: campus comes from the session (useCurrentCampus), location only as optional phone GPS kept as a distance; posters of listings may pick a landmark. Headers show the campus label, e.g. 'KJU Main'.
Dropped, never build: events, hiring, jobs, internships, gigs, food surfaces (meal plans, late-night kitchens, kitchen storefronts, student shops), the DM button rename, going-home, survey board, past papers, pets.
Not launched: change the data model freely, no backfill, no backward compatibility, delete replaced code. Never delete asset files (images, fonts, sounds); list them instead.
Done means: npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass, npm test passes for your tests, and for UI the fixture-mode browser check at 375 px and 1280 px (no horizontal scroll). End with a self-review of at most 8 lines: what you built, files touched, checks run and results, anything skipped, anything that needs a live service later.

packages.brief: Pure leaf modules, no imports. price.ts: formatPrice(n, suffix?: 'pp'|'dep'|'/mo'): under 1,000 'Rs 650'; 1,000-99,999 as k, one decimal, no trailing .0 ('Rs 1k', 'Rs 1.5k', 'Rs 12k'); 1,00,000+ as L ('Rs 1.2L'); suffix after a space ('Rs 8.5k pp', 'Rs 1.2L dep'); 0 gives 'Free'. parsePriceInput: '1.5k', '1L', '1.2 lakh', '12,000', 'Rs 8.5k', '₹900' -> number, else null. parsePriceQuery: under/below/upto/within/</max and above/over -> {min?, max?, rest} ('cycle under 12k' -> max 12000, rest 'cycle'). fairPassPrice({paid, validFrom, validUntil, now}) pro-rata by days left, down to Rs 10. isPriceDrop(prev, next) strictly lower only. distance.ts: haversineMeters; roundForPrivacy (50 m); formatDistance ('650 m' to 10 m, '1.2 km'); walkMinutes = max(1, round(m/80)); formatFromCampus(650, 'KJU') -> '650 m from KJU, 8 min walk'; DISTANCE_RINGS [500,1000,2000], DEFAULT_RING 1000, ringLabel, withinRing. Accept: npm test covers every example, a known haversine pair within 1%, and 12 of 30 days at Rs 3000 -> 1200.

packages.title: Maintenance planner for new lifecycles and account purge
packages.acceptance: npm test with fixed now values; typecheck, lint; fixture mode maintenance GET with the CRON_SECRET bearer returns counts and updates the fake DB
packages.brief: maintenance.ts: pure planMaintenance(docs, now) -> {updates, notifications}: reserved past reservedUntil -> active, notify the owner; tickets, seats and cab splits past hardExpiresAt -> expired; bundles past availableUntil -> needs_confirmation; day-3 'Still available?' nudge once per confirm (sets nudgeSentAt); games 2 h after start -> done; lost and found open 30+ days -> closed; blood requests past neededBy -> closed; delivered notifications 30+ days -> deleted. Uses listingRules.ts and notifySlots.ts (relative .ts imports). The maintenance route keeps its jobs, auth and schedule (vercel.json untouched), loads marketplace_listings, housing_posts and the utility collections, applies the plan and enqueues via notify.ts. campus-users/[id] purge also deletes blood_donors/{id}, the user's campus_notifications, campus_saves and lost_found_items, and removes the user from pickup_games players. Print jobs unchanged. Accept: npm test with fixed now values (reserve release, ticket expiry, nudge never repeats, game done); fixture: GET /api/internal/campus-maintenance with the CRON_SECRET bearer returns counts and updates the fake DB.
